question.text: The snowball strategy for debt repayment focuses on:

answer.text: Paying the highest interest rate loan first
Paying the smallest balance loan first to build momentum
Paying the largest balance loan first
Refinancing all loans at a lower rate

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 85-86 of the workbook describe the snowball repayment method as starting with the lowest debt amount, without considering interest rate. The goal is to build momentum as each debt is repaid, and the method is used as a motivational strategy. The Trap: Snowball is not interest-rate driven — that is the avalanche method. The two strategies use different ordering criteria and serve different purposes. Note: Once the smallest debt is cleared, the freed-up cashflow rolls into the next smallest debt, reinforcing the momentum effect.
